environment.description: Apollo Server v4 deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance with direct connection from application (no connection pooler). Database role 'app_service' has SELECT privileges on all tables in the public schema. JWT tokens issued by Cognito with 'sub' claim containing user UUID. No field-level authorization middleware. No row-level security policies on the database.

config.db_role_privileges: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_service
config.auth: Cognito JWT, no field-level authz directives
